facts.title: Chewypixel · React templates that feel finished
facts.description: React app templates built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Motion. Accessible, animated and ready to ship.

research.name: Chewypixel
research.note: Paid Next.js app templates (admin dashboard, AI chat, messenger) with a few free Motion-animated shadcn/ui components.
unverified: No dated changelog, release post or dated component was found on chewypixel.io (/changelog returns 404; template changelogs ship only inside the paid zip), so lastUpdated is empty.
